about-app-version.reason: the installed version (versionName and versionCode of the build), which changes with every release

settings-nav-about-summary.reason: starts with the installed version, which changes with every release

updates-installed-value.reason: the installed version (versionName and versionCode of the build), which changes with every release

new-version-meta.reason: names the installed version, which changes with every release

updates-last-checked.reason: the clock time of the scene's update check, which is when the capture runs

ssh-imported-key-name-2.reason: a key without a comment is named by the first 8 characters of its digest (#284), and no key has the board's made-up digest

ssh-imported-key-fingerprint-2.reason: the digest of the scene's imported key; no key has the board's made-up digest

saved-remote-address-studio-mac.reason: sample address: the scene's studio-mac is an ssh:// remote, because the app offers the SSH items the open board's menu draws on ssh remotes only
